scope: Reuse Stage02 observations and trajectories; no raw re-audit or upstream modification. All new solves conditional on original gyro/GNSS masks and initialization.
initial_diagnostics: input SHA and exact native time/mask/value join
all-native residual spectra and phase regression with sampling caveats
spectral_rule: Only full native ~100 Hz sequences are regridded at 100 Hz for descriptive Welch (4 s windows). Masked or ~20 Hz held-out spectra cannot establish 12 Hz dynamics. Known-wing-phase regression on subsets is a conditional parametric association, not an unaliased spectrum.
new_solve_trigger: Only if native alignment/factor audit passes and existing results cannot identify holdout-placement and missing-block effects.
shift_rule: Accel holdout boolean circularly shifted by +2 native rows in fixed 2000-row context; 20 percent remains held out. Original gyro/GNSS masks unchanged.
block_rule: Accel only: (t-target_start) mod 1s in [0.4,0.6). Replace old accel holdout. Gyro/GNSS masks unchanged. Approximately 20 percent time withheld, different difficulty from isolated samples.
integration_run_selection: A/B: existing 20ms q0.1/1/10 and 50ms q1; C: existing 20ms q1 only
integration_schemes: coupled RK4 with query at substages
interval endpoint increments and SO3 logarithm
interpretation: Arithmetic replay agreement is not physical truth; effective interval increments do not simultaneously define instantaneous acceleration and position/attitude moments. No labels or model training are produced.
